description: Reserved - Department of Fiscal Policy - Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011, order under Section 3
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains detailed tariff schedules and concessionary rates for specific goods classified under the Harmonized System, which constitutes regulatory modifications to existing legislation. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his ministerial title, and the core content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments rather than government personnel or structural changes.
